Global/Comparative courses that are also included in another group may only be counted towards fulfilling the upper division course requirements for one group.

Students in history joint major programs have the option of taking concentrations to enhance their programs.
Concentration in Middle Eastern and Islamic History
Concentration in British History and Irish History

sections.title: Upper Division Gender, Sexuality, and Women’s Studies Requirements

requirements.title: Students complete 20 upper division GSWS units

sections.note:
Courses which have high GSWS content may be considered for credit towards this plan.
With the approval of the Department of Gender, Sexuality, and Women's Studies, students may use as substitution credit one upper division course offered by another department.

sections.title: Elective Courses
sections.note: In addition to the courses listed above, students should consult an academic advisor to plan the remaining required elective courses.

grades.label: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences Degree Requirements
grades.text: For all bachelor of arts (BA) programs, students complete 120 units, which includes at least 60 units that must be completed at Simon Fraser University at least 45 upper division units, of which at least 30 upper division units must be completed at Simon Fraser University at least 60 units (including 21 upper division units) in Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences courses satisfaction of the writing, quantitative, and breadth requirements an overall cumulative grade point average (CGPA) and upper division overall CGPA of at least 2.0, and program CGPA and upper division program CGPA of at least 2.0 on the course work used to satisfy the minimum program requirements.

grades.label: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences Degree Requirements
grades.text: FASS departments may define additional GPA requirements for their respective programs.
